newsitem.title: USA: Quaker State to sell Newell, W.Va. refinery.
newsitem.headline: Quaker State to sell Newell, W.Va. refinery.

text.p: Quaker State Corp said Thursday it has signed a letter of intent to sell its Newell, W.Va. refinery to Ergon Inc for an undisclosed sum.
Quaker State said that its crude oil gathering and pipeline facilities in Ohio and Pennsylvania are included in the sale.
The company said that the sale will allow it to focus on on being a marketing firm rather than an integrated refiner and help improve shareholder return.
Ergon said that it will invest "considerable" additional capital in the operation.
A privately-held company, Ergon manufactures petroleum products and makes products including computer boards and road maintenance equipment.
